title.en: A day on the toxic-herb cabinet

tagline.zh: 鑰匙、帳本、第二個人，還有嘴麻的阿伯
tagline.en: A key, a ledger, a second person, and an uncle with a numb mouth

desc.zh: 到中藥局輪訓：審方、配伍禁忌、毒劇藥流程。你開的方，總有一天要自己抓一次。
desc.en: On rotation in the dispensary: prescription review, combination taboos, the toxic-herb workflow. One day you will dispense what you prescribe.

desc.zh: 專櫃鑰匙在你身上。開鎖、稱量、複核、專帳、盤點，每一步都要有第二個人。
desc.en: You carry the cabinet key. Unlock, weigh, verify, log, count; every step needs a second person.

role.zh: 中藥局毒劇藥負責人（師傅）

about.zh: 中醫師兼中藥師。說話慢，開鎖更慢。他說：「毒劇藥的錯誤只有一種，就是快。」
about.en: Physician and pharmacist. Speaks slowly, unlocks even more slowly. “There is only one kind of error with toxic herbs,” he says, “and it is hurry.”

role.zh: 中藥師，專櫃鑰匙保管人
role.en: Pharmacist, keeper of the cabinet key

about.zh: 鑰匙掛在脖子上，吃飯也不拿下來。專帳的字寫得像印的。
about.en: Wears the key around his neck, even at lunch. His ledger entries look printed.

about.zh: 動作快。范老師最常對她說的一句話是「慢一點」。
about.en: Quick hands. The sentence Teacher Fan says to her most is “slower”.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。退休水電師傅，膝蓋遇冷就痛。自己用市場買的「草烏」泡了一甕藥酒，說喝了嘴麻麻的才有效。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Retired plumber whose knees ache in the cold. Steeped a jar of medicinal wine with market “caowu” and says it only works when his mouth goes numb.

about.zh: 陪爸爸來拿藥。那甕藥酒是他幫忙買的材料。
about.en: Brought his father for the herbs. He is the one who bought the ingredients for that jar.

about.zh: 開附子很有心得，也很願意被攔。
about.en: Experienced with aconite, and glad to be stopped.

about.zh: 會把不懂的全部問完才掛電話。好習慣。
about.en: Asks everything she does not understand before hanging up. A good habit.

plain.zh: 法規列管、治療量與中毒量很近的藥材：附子、烏頭、馬錢子、雄黃、甘遂等。另外上鎖，另外記帳。
plain.en: Herbs on the controlled list whose treatment amount sits close to the poisoning amount: aconite, nux vomica, realgar, kansui and others. Locked separately, logged separately.

plain.zh: 毒劇藥管理的三專：單獨的櫃子、單獨的鎖與鑰匙保管人、單獨的進出登記簿，再加上專人負責。
plain.en: The three dedicated things of toxic-herb control: its own cabinet, its own lock and key keeper, its own in-and-out ledger, plus a named person in charge.

plain.zh: 古籍歸納不宜同用的藥對：烏頭反半夏、瓜蔞、貝母、白蘞、白及；甘草反甘遂、大戟、海藻、芫花；藜蘆反諸參、細辛、芍藥。
plain.en: The classical list of herb pairs not to combine: aconite with pinellia, trichosanthes, fritillaria, ampelopsis and bletilla; liquorice with kansui, euphorbia, sargassum and genkwa; veratrum with the ginsengs, asarum and peony.

plain.zh: 另一組古籍提醒互相牽制的藥對，如丁香畏鬱金、肉桂畏赤石脂、人參畏五靈脂。審方時一併查。
plain.en: A second classical list of pairs said to restrain each other, such as clove with curcuma, cinnamon bark with halloysite, ginseng with flying-squirrel droppings. Checked at review alongside the eighteen.

plain.zh: 附子、川烏、草烏裡的毒性成分。會讓心臟亂跳。炮製與久煎能讓它水解成毒性低得多的物質。
plain.en: The toxic alkaloid in aconite roots. It makes the heart beat chaotically. Processing and long cooking hydrolyse it into far less toxic compounds.

plain.zh: 附子經鹽漬、漂、蒸、煮等炮製後的飲片（黑順片、白附片、淡附片）。生附子不可直接入藥。
plain.en: Aconite that has been brined, soaked, steamed or boiled into its processed grades. Raw aconite is never dispensed as it is.

plain.zh: 附子類要先下鍋煮很長一段時間，再加其他藥。時間依藥典與處方標示，不憑感覺。
plain.en: Aconite-type herbs are boiled alone for a long time before the rest is added. The length follows the pharmacopoeia and the prescription, not feel.

plain.zh: 傳統上附子煎好的判斷：舀一小口嘗，舌頭不麻才算煎透。還麻，繼續煎，不能喝。
plain.en: The traditional check that aconite is cooked through: a sip that no longer numbs the tongue. Still numb means keep cooking and do not drink.

plain.zh: 脈跳得慢而且不規則地停一下。中醫認為多見於心氣不足或寒凝血瘀；現代看，就是心律不整，要做心電圖。
plain.en: A slow pulse that skips irregularly. In TCM reasoning it suggests weak heart qi or cold congealing the blood; in modern terms it is an arrhythmia and needs an ECG.

plain.zh: 中醫認為寒邪留在關節，痛處固定、遇冷更痛、得熱減輕。溫經散寒的附子常用於此。
plain.en: In TCM reasoning cold lodged in a joint: fixed pain, worse in cold, eased by warmth. Aconite, which warms the channels, is a classic choice here.

plain.zh: 把藥材泡在酒裡。酒精會把烏頭鹼大量溶出來，沒有久煎的減毒，所以自泡烏頭藥酒是最常見的中毒來源。
plain.en: Herbs steeped in spirits. Alcohol pulls out large amounts of aconitine with none of the detoxifying long cook, which is why home-made aconite wine is the commonest source of poisoning.

plain.zh: 毒劇藥的每一次取用、稱量、登記，都要兩個人分別簽名。一個人簽兩次不算。
plain.en: Every withdrawal, weighing and log entry of a toxic herb is signed by two different people. One person signing twice does not count.

plain.zh: 把礦物藥用火燒。龍骨、牡蠣可以煅；雄黃絕對不行，遇火會生成砒霜。
plain.en: Heating a mineral herb in fire. Dragon bone and oyster shell may be calcined; realgar never, because fire turns it into arsenic trioxide.

plain.zh: 劇毒的砷化合物。雄黃含砷，加熱後會變成它，所以雄黃忌火煅、不可內服。
plain.en: A deadly arsenic compound. Realgar contains arsenic and turns into it when heated, so realgar is never calcined and never taken internally.

text.zh: 鋼櫃、雙鎖、鑰匙專人保管。裡面每一味都有自己的帳頁：進多少、出多少、剩多少、誰簽的。
text.en: Steel, double-locked, key with a named keeper. Every herb inside has its own ledger page: in, out, balance, and who signed.

text.zh: 紙本加電子各一份。用鋼筆，不用鉛筆；寫錯畫一線加簽名，不塗改。
text.en: Paper and electronic copies both. Ink, never pencil; a mistake is struck through once and initialled, never erased.

text.zh: 毒劇藥用電子天平，歸零、稱量、第二人看數字、兩人簽複核單。戥秤留給不會致命的藥。
text.en: Toxic herbs go on the electronic balance: zero, weigh, a second person reads the figure, both sign the slip. The steelyard is for herbs that cannot kill.

text.zh: 系統會跳十八反、十九畏與孕婦禁忌警示。警示不是拿來按掉的，是拿來打電話的。
text.en: The system flags the eighteen antagonisms, nineteen incompatibilities and pregnancy taboos. A flag is not for dismissing; it is for phoning.

text.zh: 市場買的「草烏」泡米酒。送急診時一起帶去了，急診醫師說這瓶比病歷有用。
text.en: Market “caowu” in rice spirit. It went to the emergency department with him; the doctor there said the jar was more useful than the chart.

text.zh: 專櫃、專鎖、專帳、專人。取用要處方與醫師簽章、雙人開鎖、稱量複核雙簽、登帳、鎖回。盤點帳物相符；不符時封存回報，不補帳。
text.en: Dedicated cabinet, lock, ledger and person. Withdrawal needs a signed prescription, two people to unlock, weighing verified and double-signed, a ledger entry, and the lock closed again. Stock-takes must match the book; a mismatch is sealed and reported, never written away.

text.zh: 烏頭鹼遇水、遇熱會水解成毒性低很多的物質。炮製先減一層，先煎久煎再減一層，兩層缺一不可。酒精相反，把烏頭鹼溶得更多，所以藥酒最危險。
text.en: Aconitine hydrolyses in water and heat into far less toxic compounds. Processing strips one layer; decocting first and long strips another; neither can be skipped. Alcohol does the opposite, dissolving more aconitine out, which is why wine is the most dangerous form.

name.zh: 烏頭鹼中毒：紅旗與處置
name.en: Aconitine poisoning: red flags and response

text.zh: 口唇舌麻、噁心嘔吐、心悸、脈結代或亂跳、頭暈血壓低、四肢麻。沒有特效解毒劑，靠急診心電圖監測與支持治療。中藥局能做的：立刻停、叫救護車、保留樣品、通知醫師。甘草綠豆湯不是急救。
text.en: Numb lips and tongue, nausea and vomiting, palpitations, a knotted or chaotic pulse, dizziness with low pressure, numb limbs. There is no specific antidote; survival depends on ECG monitoring and supportive care in emergency. What the dispensary does: stop at once, call an ambulance, keep the sample, tell the doctor. Liquorice-and-mung-bean soup is not first aid.

text.zh: 十八反、十九畏是古籍的經驗提醒，不是全部有現代證據，但處方同時出現時，規定是：停、問醫師、由醫師簽註理由後才調劑。調劑人員不自己刪藥，也不自己放行。
text.en: The eighteen antagonisms and nineteen incompatibilities are classical cautions, not all backed by modern evidence; but when a pair appears on one prescription the rule is stop, ask the prescriber, and dispense only after the doctor signs a reason. The dispenser neither removes the herb nor waves it through alone.

lines.zh: 中藥局八點。百子櫃已經開了，角落那座鋼櫃還鎖著。阿坤的鑰匙在脖子上晃。
lines.en: The dispensary at eight. The herb cabinet is open; the steel cabinet in the corner is still locked. Kun's key swings on its cord.

lines.zh: 今天你跟這一櫃。先告訴我，什麼叫毒劇藥，為什麼不放百子櫃？
lines.en: Today you are with this cabinet. First tell me: what are toxic and potent herbs, and why are they not in the main cabinet?

lines.zh: 法規列管、治療量和中毒量很近的藥材。要專櫃、專鎖、專帳。
lines.en: Controlled herbs whose treatment amount sits close to the poisoning amount. They need their own cabinet, lock, ledger.

lines.zh: 還有專人。就是我。找找看櫃子在哪，順便看鎖有幾道。
lines.en: And their own person. That is me. Find the cabinet, and count the locks while you are there.

q.zh: 找到上鎖的毒劇藥專櫃

post.zh: 兩道鎖，兩把鑰匙，一把在我、一把在范老師。一個人開不了，這是設計，不是不信任。
post.en: Two locks, two keys: one with me, one with Teacher Fan. One person cannot open it. That is design, not distrust.

lines.zh: 昨天進貨混了一盤。哪些該進這座櫃子？拿錯就是帳對不起來。
lines.en: Yesterday's delivery came mixed on one tray. Which of these go in this cabinet? Get one wrong and the ledger will not balance.

q.zh: 挑出屬於毒劇藥、必須進專櫃管理的藥材
q.en: Select the toxic and potent herbs that must go into the controlled cabinet

post.zh: 附子溫陽但含烏頭鹼；馬錢子劇毒；雄黃含砷；甘遂峻下；生天南星麻舌。都是能治病也能出事的藥。
post.en: Aconite warms yang but carries aconitine; nux vomica is deadly; realgar holds arsenic; kansui purges violently; raw arisaema numbs the tongue. Each can heal and each can hurt.

post.zh: 進櫃之前先登帳。五步，順序不能亂，我念一次你排一次。
post.en: Before anything goes in, it goes in the book. Five steps in a fixed order; I say them once, you arrange them.

guide.zh: 到專帳桌排出取藥流程
guide.en: Lay out the withdrawal steps at the ledger desk

lines.zh: 以後每一次從這座櫃子拿藥，都走這五步。少一步，帳就是錯的。
lines.en: Every withdrawal from this cabinet, from now on, follows these five steps. Skip one and the ledger is wrong.

q.zh: 毒劇藥取用的正確順序
q.en: The correct order for withdrawing a toxic herb

post.zh: 注意最後一步。多少帳對不起來，是因為有人想「等一下再鎖」。
post.en: Mind the last step. Most ledger mismatches come from someone who meant to “lock it in a minute”.

note.zh: 寒痹方；十八反警示要打電話
note.en: A cold-bi formula; an antagonism flag means a phone call

lines.zh: 許醫師的方：羅阿伯，六十八歲，膝痛遇冷加重。有炮附子，註明先煎。先看舌。
lines.en: Dr Hsu's prescription: Uncle Lo, sixty-eight, knee pain worse in the cold. Processed aconite, marked decoct first. Look at the tongue first.

lines.zh: 舌淡，苔白而厚，有點滑。
lines.en: Pale tongue, thick white coat, a little moist.

q.zh: 羅阿伯的舌：淡、苔白厚而滑。膝痛固定、遇冷加重、得熱減輕。證型？
q.en: Uncle Lo's tongue: pale, thick moist white coat. Fixed knee pain, worse in cold, better with warmth. The pattern?

options.zh: 寒濕痹阻
options.en: Cold-damp painful obstruction

why.zh: 舌淡苔白滑是寒濕；痛處固定、遇冷重、得熱輕是寒痹的典型。溫經散寒的附子因此入方。
why.en: A pale tongue with a moist white coat means cold-damp; fixed pain worse in cold and eased by heat is textbook cold bi. That is why warming aconite is in the formula.

options.zh: 濕熱痹
options.en: Damp-heat painful obstruction

why.zh: 濕熱痹關節紅腫熱痛、苔黃膩、口渴。這裡苔白、怕冷。
why.en: Damp-heat bi gives a red, hot, swollen joint, a greasy yellow coat and thirst. Here the coat is white and he hates the cold.

options.zh: 肝腎陰虛
options.en: Liver-kidney yin deficiency

why.zh: 陰虛舌紅少苔、腰膝痠軟、夜間潮熱。和厚白苔、怕冷不合。
why.en: Yin deficiency gives a red tongue with little coat, weak aching lower back and night heat. Not a thick white coat and chills.

options.zh: 瘀血阻絡
options.en: Blood stasis blocking the channels

why.zh: 瘀血痛如針刺、夜間加重、舌紫有瘀斑。阿伯的舌是淡的。
why.en: Stasis pain is stabbing, worse at night, with a purple spotted tongue. Uncle Lo's tongue is pale.

post.zh: 寒濕痹阻，附子有道理。現在看下面幾味。系統跳了一個紅色警示。
post.en: Cold painful obstruction with damp: aconite makes sense. Now the rest of the list. The system has raised a red flag.

lines.zh: 警示寫「十八反」。附子是烏頭的子根。烏頭反哪些藥？從盤子裡挑。
lines.en: The flag says “eighteen antagonisms”. Aconite is the daughter root of wutou. What does wutou antagonise? Pick them from the tray.

q.zh: 依十八反，烏頭類（含附子）相反的藥材有哪些？
q.en: By the eighteen antagonisms, which herbs clash with the aconite family?

post.zh: 處方上有半夏。附子加半夏，同一張。現在你是審方的人，怎麼辦？
post.en: Pinellia is on this prescription. Aconite and pinellia on the same sheet. You are the reviewer; what now?

lines.zh: 許醫師開附子很有經驗。但經驗不是簽名。
lines.en: Dr Hsu is experienced with aconite. But experience is not a signature.

q.zh: 處方同時有炮附子與半夏，系統跳出十八反警示。你怎麼做？
q.en: Processed aconite and pinellia on one prescription; the system flags an antagonism. What do you do?

options.zh: 醫師開的，按掉警示照抓
options.en: The doctor wrote it; dismiss and dispense

why.zh: 按掉的警示沒有人會再看到。規定是停下來問，由醫師簽註理由。
why.en: A dismissed flag is seen by nobody again. The rule is stop and ask, and the doctor signs the reason.

options.zh: 打給許醫師確認，請他簽註
options.en: Phone Dr Hsu and ask him to sign a note

why.zh: 配伍禁忌出現時的唯一正確路徑：停、問、簽註、再調劑。
why.en: The only right path when a taboo pair appears: stop, ask, get the note, then dispense.

options.zh: 自己把半夏拿掉，比較安全
options.en: Remove the pinellia myself; safer

why.zh: 調劑人員沒有刪藥的權限。安全的動作做在錯的位置，還是錯。
why.en: A dispenser has no authority to delete a herb. A safe act in the wrong hands is still an error.

lines.zh: 半夏我拿掉，改陳皮化痰就好。謝謝你攔。警示我沒注意到。
lines.en: I'll drop the pinellia; tangerine peel will do for the phlegm. Thanks for stopping it; I missed the flag.

lines.zh: 收到，半夏改陳皮。附子先煎久煎、煎到不麻口，我會寫在藥包上。
lines.en: Noted: pinellia out, tangerine peel in. Aconite gets a long decoction first, until there is no numbing on the tongue; I'll write it on the packet.

lines.zh: 麻煩你多叮嚀他。那位阿伯，我記得他會自己泡藥酒。
lines.en: Please remind him well. That uncle, if I remember, makes his own medicinal wine.

guide.en: Stopped by Teacher Fan at verification

lines.zh: 這張附子和半夏同在，警示誰按掉的？簽註在哪？
lines.en: Aconite and pinellia on the same sheet. Who dismissed the flag? Where is the note?

lines.zh: ……我以為許醫師有經驗。我現在打電話。
lines.en: …I assumed Dr Hsu knew. I'll phone now.

lines.zh: 許醫師在電話裡沉默了兩秒：「我沒注意到。半夏改陳皮。下次先攔我。」
lines.en: Two seconds of silence on the line, then Dr Hsu: “I missed it. Pinellia to tangerine peel. Next time stop me first.”

lines.zh: 記住這兩秒。醫師也會漏，所以才有你。
lines.en: Remember those two seconds. Doctors miss things; that is why you exist.

note.zh: 電子天平、複核、雙簽；先煎久煎
note.en: Balance, verification, two signatures; first and long

lines.zh: 毒劇藥不用戥秤，用電子天平。歸零、稱、我看數字、兩個人簽。
lines.en: No steelyard for toxic herbs; the electronic balance. Zero, weigh, I read the figure, two signatures.

lines.zh: 黑順片，切面油潤、黑褐色。對的規格。
lines.en: Black aconite slices, glossy cut face, dark brown. The right grade.

lines.zh: 對規格是第一步。生附子長得不一樣，灰白色、嘗了舌頭會麻。你不會嘗，對吧？
lines.en: Grade is step one. Raw aconite looks different: greyish white, and it numbs the tongue. You will not taste it, will you?

lines.zh: 有毒的，永遠不嘗。
lines.en: Toxic herbs, never.

post.zh: 數字我看過了。你簽、我簽、登帳、鎖回。現在，不是等一下。
post.en: I've read the figure. You sign, I sign, ledger, lock. Now, not in a minute.

guide.zh: 為什麼炮製了還要久煎
guide.en: Why processed and still cooked long

lines.zh: 問你一個每個病人都會問的問題：都炮製過了，為什麼還要先煎久煎？
lines.en: A question every patient asks: it is already processed, so why decoct it first and long?

q.zh: 炮附子為什麼仍要先煎、久煎？
q.en: Why does processed aconite still need to be decocted first and long?

options.zh: 炮製與久煎都讓烏頭鹼水解
options.en: Both hydrolyse the aconitine

why.zh: 炮製減一層毒，加水加熱再減一層；兩層都做，剩下的毒性才低到可以用。
why.en: Processing strips one layer of toxicity; water and heat strip another. Only with both does what remains fall low enough to use.

options.zh: 煎久一點味道比較好
options.en: It tastes better cooked longer

why.zh: 附子煎再久也不好喝。久煎是安全，不是口味。
why.en: Aconite never tastes good. The long cook is about safety, not flavour.

options.zh: 炮製過就夠了，久煎是習慣
options.en: Processing is enough; the long cook is habit

why.zh: 中毒個案裡不少是炮附子沒煎夠。炮製不是保險。
why.en: Many poisoning cases involve processed aconite that was under-cooked. Processing is not insurance.

post.zh: 還有一個相反的例子：酒。酒精把烏頭鹼溶得更多，沒有久煎。待會窗口你會遇到。
post.en: And the opposite example: spirits. Alcohol dissolves more aconitine out and there is no long cook. You will meet that at the window shortly.

lines.zh: 藥包上的煎法要寫到阿伯看得懂。順序排給我看。
lines.en: The cooking label must make sense to Uncle Lo himself. Put the steps in order for me.

q.zh: 含炮附子處方的煎法順序
q.en: Cooking order for a prescription containing processed aconite

steps.en: Processed aconite alone, first and long

steps.zh: 嘗一小口，不麻口才算煎透
steps.en: A sip: no numbing means cooked through
If still numbing: do not drink; report

post.zh: 最後一條最重要。麻，就不喝，打電話。藥袋上印粗體。
post.en: The last line matters most. Numb means do not drink; phone us. Bold type on the bag.

name.en: The window: that jar of wine

note.zh: 嘴麻不是藥效；結脈、心悸，叫救護車
note.en: Numbness is not efficacy; knotted pulse, palpitations, ambulance

guide.en: See Uncle Lo at the window

lines.zh: 醫生啊，我自己有泡藥酒，草烏加米酒，喝了嘴麻麻的，膝蓋就不痛。這樣有效對不對？
lines.en: Doctor, I make my own medicinal wine, caowu in rice spirit. My mouth goes numb and the knee stops hurting. That means it's working, right?

lines.zh: 草烏是我幫他在市場買的。賣的人說泡酒最好。
lines.en: I bought the caowu for him at the market. The seller said wine was the best way.

lines.zh: 阿伯，嘴麻是烏頭鹼在作用。那不是藥效到了，是中毒開始了。
lines.en: Uncle, the numb mouth is aconitine at work. That is not the medicine arriving; that is poisoning beginning.

q.zh: 羅阿伯說喝自泡草烏藥酒後「嘴麻才有效」。正確的回應？
q.en: Uncle Lo says his home-made caowu wine “only works when the mouth goes numb”. The right response?

options.zh: 立刻停、留樣品、今天就告訴醫師
options.en: Stop now, keep the sample, tell the doctor today

why.zh: 口唇麻是烏頭鹼中毒最早的訊號。酒精溶出大量烏頭鹼，沒有久煎減毒。停、留樣、通知。
why.en: Numb lips are the earliest sign of aconitine poisoning. Spirits pull out large amounts with no long cook. Stop, keep the sample, notify.

options.zh: 嘴麻代表藥力夠，可以繼續
options.en: Numbness means it is strong enough; carry on

why.zh: 這句話害過很多人。麻是毒，不是效。
why.en: This sentence has hurt many people. Numbness is toxicity, not effect.

options.zh: 加甘草一起泡就安全了
options.en: Add liquorice to the jar and it is safe

why.zh: 民間說法。甘草不會中和酒裡的烏頭鹼。安全的做法只有不喝。
why.en: Folk belief. Liquorice does not neutralise aconitine in spirits. The only safe version is not drinking it.

post.zh: ……我今天早上才喝了一杯。
post.en: …I had a cup this morning.

post.zh: 手伸出來。
post.en: Give me your wrist.

guide.en: Feel the pulse with Teacher Fan

lines.zh: 你也按。寸關尺，先輕後重。數它的節律，不要只感覺力道。
lines.en: You press too. Cun, guan, chi; light then deep. Count its rhythm, not only its strength.

lines.zh: 慢……然後停一下，又跳。停的間隔不規則。
lines.en: Slow… then a pause, then it goes again. The pauses are irregular.

q.zh: 羅阿伯的脈：慢，不規則地停一下再跳。這是什麼脈？
q.en: Uncle Lo's pulse: slow, with irregular pauses. Name it.

options.zh: 結脈
options.en: Knotted pulse

why.zh: 脈緩而時一止、止無定數，是結脈。中醫認為多屬寒凝或心氣虛；今天的解讀只有一個：心律不整，剛喝過烏頭藥酒。
why.en: Slow with irregular stops is the knotted pulse. TCM reads cold congealing or weak heart qi; today it has one reading only: an arrhythmia in a man who just drank aconite wine.

options.zh: 遲脈
options.en: Slow pulse

why.zh: 遲脈只是慢，節律是整齊的。這個會停。
why.en: A slow pulse is merely slow, with a regular rhythm. This one stops.

options.zh: 細脈
options.en: Thready pulse

why.zh: 細脈講的是寬窄，不是節律。
why.en: Thready describes width, not rhythm.

options.zh: 弦脈
options.en: Wiry pulse

why.zh: 弦脈像按琴弦，直而長，節律正常。
why.en: A wiry pulse is like a string, straight and long, rhythm intact.

post.zh: 結脈。阿伯，你現在有沒有心悸、想吐、手腳麻？
post.en: Knotted. Uncle, do you have palpitations, nausea, numb hands or feet right now?

post.zh: ……心臟跳得怪怪的。頭有點暈。
post.en: …My heart's beating strangely. A bit dizzy.

lines.zh: 阿伯額頭冒汗，手扶著窗口。小芳已經在撥電話。
lines.en: Sweat on Uncle Lo's forehead; his hand grips the counter. Hsiao-Fang is already dialling.

options.zh: 叫救護車，平躺，藥酒瓶一起送
options.en: Ambulance, lie flat, send the jar with him

why.zh: 烏頭鹼中毒沒有特效解毒劑，心律不整隨時會惡化，要急診心電圖監測。樣品讓急診知道是什麼。
why.en: Aconitine poisoning has no antidote and the arrhythmia can worsen at any moment; he needs ECG monitoring in emergency. The sample tells them what it is.

options.zh: 煮甘草綠豆湯幫他解毒
options.en: Cook liquorice and mung bean soup to detoxify

why.zh: 民間解毒方不是急救。煮湯的時間，是心律惡化的時間。
why.en: A folk antidote is not first aid. The time spent cooking soup is time for the rhythm to deteriorate.

options.zh: 先觀察，等一下再看
options.en: Watch and wait a while

why.zh: 結脈加心悸加剛喝烏頭酒，沒有「等一下」。
why.en: Knotted pulse, palpitations and fresh aconite wine leave no room for “a while”.

post.zh: 救護車來了。羅先生，瓶子跟著去，急診醫師會想看。
post.en: The ambulance is here. Mr Lo, the jar goes with him; the emergency doctor will want to see it.

post.zh: 是我買的材料……
post.en: I bought the ingredients…

post.zh: 你今天也把他帶來了。這件事以後再說，先跟車。
post.en: And you brought him here today. We talk about the rest later; go with the ambulance.

guide.en: The window is empty; listen to Teacher Fan

lines.zh: 中藥局最常見的中毒不是處方，是家裡那甕酒。所以窗口的每一句閒聊都要聽。
lines.en: The commonest poisoning this dispensary sees is not a prescription; it is the jar at home. That is why every bit of small talk at the window is listened to.

lines.zh: 如果我剛剛只顧著講煎法……
lines.en: If I had only talked about cooking instructions…

lines.zh: 他會回家，再喝一杯。紅旗看到就轉，中藥局也一樣。
lines.en: He would have gone home and had another cup. See a red flag, refer. That applies in a dispensary too.

note.zh: 雄黃忌火煅；外用也有規矩
note.en: Realgar is never calcined; topical use has rules too

sub.zh: 小楊：外用藥膏可以加熱嗎
sub.en: Nurse Yang: can the ointment be warmed?

lines.zh: 中藥局嗎？我們有位住民的外用膏，成分有雄黃。冬天膏太硬，可以用火烤軟一點嗎？
lines.en: Dispensary? One of our residents has a topical paste containing realgar. It's stiff in winter; can we warm it over a flame?

lines.zh: 請先不要。雄黃含砷，遇火會變成砒霜。
lines.en: Please don't. Realgar contains arsenic; calcining or flaming it turns it into arsenic trioxide.

q.zh: 含雄黃的外用膏太硬，護理師問能不能用火烤軟。
q.en: A realgar-containing paste is too stiff; the nurse asks about softening it over a flame.

options.zh: 不可煅烤；溫水隔水回軟即可
options.en: Never flame it; soften in a warm water bath

why.zh: 雄黃忌火煅。隔水微溫不會分解；火烤會。而且只能外用、不可大面積久敷、不可碰破皮黏膜。
why.en: Realgar is never calcined. A gentle water bath does not decompose it; a flame does. And it stays external only, never on large areas for long, never on broken skin or mucosa.

options.zh: 小火烤一下沒關係
options.en: A quick low flame is fine

why.zh: 沒有「安全的小火」。砒霜的生成不看火的大小。
why.en: There is no “safe low flame”. Arsenic trioxide does not care how small the fire is.

options.zh: 改口服比較方便
options.en: Switch to taking it by mouth

why.zh: 雄黃不可內服。這一題沒有任何口服的選項。
why.en: Realgar is never taken internally. There is no oral option in this question.

post.zh: 懂了，隔水溫。另外附子那帖我們照標示煎了，嘗過不麻才給。
post.en: Got it, water bath. And we cooked the aconite pack as labelled and tasted for numbness before giving it.

post.zh: 這通電話，值一個下午。
post.en: That phone call was worth the whole afternoon.

note.zh: 帳物不符：封存回報，不補帳
note.en: Book and stock differ: seal, report, never write it away

lines.zh: 每天關櫃前盤一次。我念帳，你數實物。
lines.en: Counted every evening before locking. I read the book, you count the stock.

lines.zh: 附子對、雄黃對、甘遂對……馬錢子，實物比帳少一包。
lines.en: Aconite matches, realgar matches, kansui matches… nux vomica: one packet fewer than the book.

lines.zh: 停。不要再動櫃子。
lines.en: Stop. Do not touch the cabinet again.

q.zh: 盤點發現馬錢子實物比專帳少一包。你怎麼做？
q.en: The count shows one packet of nux vomica fewer than the ledger. What do you do?

options.zh: 封存、停用、立刻回報范老師
options.en: Seal it, freeze it, report to Teacher Fan now

why.zh: 帳物不符是通報事件。封存現場、兩人簽名、追查當天每一筆取用，不補帳也不猜。
why.en: A mismatch is a reportable event. Seal the scene, two signatures, trace every withdrawal of the day; never adjust the book, never guess.

options.zh: 帳上改成實際數量就平了
options.en: Correct the ledger to the actual count

why.zh: 把帳改到跟實物一樣，叫做湮滅紀錄。一包馬錢子不見，一定要找到去哪了。
why.en: Editing the book to match the stock is destroying the record. A missing packet of nux vomica must be found.

options.zh: 明天再盤一次，可能數錯
options.en: Count again tomorrow; probably miscounted

why.zh: 重數可以，但今天就重數、就回報。毒劇藥不過夜。
why.en: Recount, yes, but today, and report today. Toxic herbs do not wait overnight.

post.zh: 追查登記：上午許醫師另一張處方的馬錢子有稱量複核單，卻漏了登帳。小芳臉紅了。
post.en: The trace: a nux vomica withdrawal for another of Dr Hsu's prescriptions this morning has a weighing slip but no ledger line. Hsiao-Fang goes red.

post.zh: ……我想說等一下再登。
post.en: …I meant to log it in a minute.

post.zh: 「等一下」。我早上說過了。補登、雙簽、寫事件報告。沒人罵你，但要寫。
post.en: “In a minute.” I said it this morning. Log it now, double sign, write the incident report. Nobody is shouting, but it gets written.

guide.zh: 把混放的普通飲片歸回百子櫃
guide.en: Return the ordinary pieces to the main cabinet

lines.zh: 專櫃旁邊這盤是今天分揀出來的普通飲片，各自回百子櫃。認清楚再放。
lines.en: This tray beside the cabinet is today's sorted-out ordinary pieces. Each goes back to its drawer. Identify, then place.

post.zh: 今天的事說一次：一個警示、一甕酒、一包沒登帳。哪一個最危險？
post.en: Today, once over: one flag, one jar, one unlogged packet. Which was most dangerous?

post.zh: 那甕酒。因為它不在任何系統裡。
post.en: The jar. Because it was in no system at all.

post.zh: 對。系統管得到的，我們慢慢做；系統管不到的，靠耳朵。
post.en: Right. What the system can reach, we do slowly; what it cannot reach, we catch by listening.

note.zh: 阿伯心律恢復；鑰匙回到脖子上
note.en: Uncle Lo's rhythm is back; the key returns to its cord

sub.en: Emergency says the rhythm is back

lines.zh: 急診說是烏頭鹼，監測一晚，心律已經穩了。醫師說那瓶子救了很多時間。藥酒我倒掉了。
lines.en: Emergency says aconitine. He's monitored overnight and the rhythm has settled. The doctor said the jar saved a lot of time. I've poured the wine away.

lines.zh: 好。明天讓他回許醫師門診，寒痹照方煎藥，不泡酒。
lines.en: Good. Tomorrow he goes back to Dr Hsu; the knee gets the decoction, cooked as written, and no wine.

lines.zh: 阿坤把鑰匙掛回脖子上，兩道鎖都檢查了一次。然後又檢查了一次。
lines.en: Kun hangs the key back around his neck and checks both locks. Then checks them again.

lines.zh: 毒劇藥的錯誤只有一種，就是快。今天你慢了三次，很好。回去吧。
lines.en: There is only one error with toxic herbs: hurry. Today you were slow three times. Well done. Go home.

sub.zh: 慢了三次，救了一個阿伯
sub.en: Slow three times; one uncle safe
